Definition: a Persian woman; Persis, a Christian female:--Persis.
BiblicalUsage: Persis is a Christian woman Paul greets in his letter to Rome, and he adds that she laboured much in the Lord. Her name is all we know of her, apart from that one line of praise from the apostle.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Persis shows me God notices quiet labour: one verse, one name, and a lifetime of work for the Lord remembered forever.
